create_cityscapes_dataset: create a CityScapesDataset instance with image and annotation directories for train or val split
process_binary_masks: process CityScapes binary instance ID masks into bounding boxes, segmentations, and labels
process_polygons: process CityScapes polygon annotations from JSON files into bounding boxes, polygons, and labels
filter_ground_truth: filter ground truth boxes and segmentations by minimum bounding box area threshold
get_image_info: get image metadata including height, width, and file paths for a given dataset index
